## Current focus

I build software that records evidence as it runs so humans and agents can inspect,
replay, challenge, and safely act on what happened.

The core design rule is:

**Record the path at the moment it happens. Never reconstruct it afterward.**

The footprintjs ecosystem applies that rule to four journeys:

1. Backend execution — FootPrint
2. Agent reasoning — AgentFootprint
3. Application interaction — HACI Footprint
4. Exploratory analysis — VizFootprint

Three companion evidence lenses make those records understandable to people and developers:

5. Backend execution lens — Explainable UI
6. Agent debugging lens — AgentFootprint Lens
7. Human-facing reasoning replay — Thinking UI

## Systems

### FootPrint — execution provenance

- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/footPrint
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/footprintjs
- Turns business logic into a directed graph whose execution record is created inline.
- Records typed reads, writes, branches, state changes, decisions, and causes.
- Supports transactional state, parallel fork/join, streaming, checkpoints, replay, and variable-first backward slicing.

### AgentFootprint — context provenance

- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/agentfootprint
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/agentfootprint
- Playground: https://footprintjs.github.io/agent-playground/
- Records context injections, model calls, tool decisions, execution state, cost, and failure causes.
- Context-bug localization combines slicing, influence ranking, ablation, and counterfactual replay.
- Supports multiple providers, MCP, causal memory, pause/resume, and typed event streams.

### HACI Footprint — application capability provenance

- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/hcifootprint
- Docs: https://footprintjs.github.io/hcifootprint/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/hcifootprint
- Demo: https://youtu.be/vx5amF94ipI
- Turns a web application's real interaction surface into a typed capability graph served over MCP.
- Preserves permissions, preconditions, confirmation gates, and the signed-in user's authority.
- Supports a read-only guide mode for incremental adoption.

### VizFootprint — exploration provenance (pre-alpha)

- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/vizfootprint
- Trail Pattern: https://footprintjs.github.io/blog/the-trail-pattern/
- Records exploratory visual analysis as an append-only, parent-linked trail shared by humans and agents.
- Preserves abandoned branches instead of erasing them when an analysis changes direction.
- Supports named paths, comparison, replay, adoption, archive/restore, and statistical memory across the complete history.

## Evidence lenses

### Explainable UI — backend execution lens

- Demo: https://footprintjs.github.io/explainable-ui/
- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/explainable-ui
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/footprint-explainable-ui
- React components for FootPrint flowchart traversal, transactional state inspection, time travel, and causal rewind.

### AgentFootprint Lens — agent debugging lens

- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/agentfootprint-lens
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/agentfootprint-lens
- Aligns messages, prompts, tools, decisions, causal slices, and cost on one execution cursor.

### Thinking UI — human-facing reasoning replay

- Demo: https://footprintjs.github.io/agentThinkingUI/
- Source: https://github.com/footprintjs/agentThinkingUI
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/agentthinkingui
- Replays agent reasoning, evidence, tool choices, and scored alternatives as a scrubbable, inspectable story.

## Research

### Visible Reasoning

Reliable agent transparency should come from recorded decision evidence owned by the
runtime, not from asking a model to narrate or judge its own reasoning.

Visible Reasoning: User-Facing Decision Transparency for Generative AI Systems —
HCI International 2026, LNCS 16745, pp. 3–21, Springer.

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-30849-8_1
- Reference implementations: https://github.com/footprintjs/visible-reasoning

Earlier work: Bridging UI Design and Chatbot Interactions — HCI International 2025.

## Career evolution

1. HCI and visual analytics — made complex data-exploration sessions understandable to people through PhD work and Weave.
2. State architecture — StateTree made interaction state inspectable, comparable, and reversible.
3. Production engineering — large systems exposed the limits of logs that preserve events without causal structure.
4. Execution provenance — FootPrint made backend code record its own reads, writes, branches, and causes.
5. Context provenance — AgentFootprint and Visible Reasoning extended recorded evidence to context, models, tools, and replay.
6. Application interaction — HACI Footprint defined what agents can safely see and do inside real applications.
7. Exploration provenance — VizFootprint extended the work to open-ended human and agent analysis.
8. Current focus — provenance-native human-agent systems with evidence created during execution and interaction.
